summary: On the train platform, Marta tries to shove her plastic Deutschlandticket chip card into the narrow slot of a yellow ticket validator. Lukas warns her in time, explaining that monthly chip cards are already valid and do not need stamping.
cliffhanger: Next time, Marta checks the carriage doors to find the quiet zone compartment.
visual_hook: Marta firmly trying to push a rigid plastic card into the thin paper slit of a yellow platform stamping box.
everyday_problem: Newcomers often mistake regional transit validators as mandatory for all tickets, risking damage to plastic chip cards or mobile phones.
practical_resolution: Lukas clarifies that the subscription chip card is already valid without mechanical validation.
marta_goal: Validate her new transit ticket correctly before boarding the train.
marta_decision: Pull the plastic chip card safely away from the narrow slot and put it in her jacket pocket ready for ticket inspection.
visual_payoff: Marta inspects her intact plastic card with relief, taps it playfully against her palm, and leads the way onto the arriving train.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.scene: Medium shot of Marta on the sunlit station platform, pointing her rigid chip card toward the yellow ticket punch box mounted on a metal pole.
scenes.motion: Marta steps up toward the yellow validator post and raises her plastic card proudly.
scenes.object_action: Marta points her plastic chip card at the slot of the yellow ticket validator.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.scene: Close-up framing of Marta's hand and face as she attempts to force the thick plastic edge into the paper slit.
scenes.motion: Marta wiggles the plastic card firmly against the narrow metal opening with a puzzled frown.
scenes.object_action: Marta presses the plastic card against the validator slot, failing to slide it in.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.fa: مارتا، صبر کن! لطفاً مهر نزن!
scenes.scene: Medium shot of Lukas standing on the platform, eyes wide, raising an open palm to halt her.
scenes.motion: Lukas lifts both hands in a friendly stop gesture, shaking his head quickly.
scenes.object_action: Lukas extends an open hand toward the yellow validator to stop the action.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.scene: Closer framing of Marta turning toward the camera, holding the card suspended millimeters before the slot.
scenes.motion: Marta pauses her hand, tilting her head with an inquiring expression.
scenes.object_action: Marta holds the plastic card steady right in front of the validator opening.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Nein, dieses Ticket ist schon gültig.
scenes.fa: نه، این بلیط از قبل معتبر است.
scenes.scene: Medium close-up of Lukas pulling his own identical transit chip card out of his jacket.
scenes.motion: Lukas displays his flat chip card horizontally with a calm, reassuring smile.
scenes.object_action: Lukas holds his transit chip card flat between his thumb and index finger.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.fa: پس به هیچ مهری نیاز ندارم؟
scenes.scene: Closer framing of Marta pulling her card back toward her chest and examining both sides.
scenes.motion: Marta turns the plastic card over in her fingers, looking over the smooth printed surface.
scenes.object_action: Marta flips the plastic card over in both hands.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Richtig, du zeigst es nur vor.
scenes.fa: درست است، فقط آن را نشان می‌دهی.
scenes.scene: Medium shot of Lukas miming a ticket inspection by presenting his card outward at chest height.
scenes.motion: Lukas holds his card forward as if showing it to a train conductor.
scenes.object_action: Lukas presents his card forward toward an imaginary inspector.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.fa: پس این جعبه چه کار می‌کند؟
scenes.scene: Medium framing of Marta pointing one index finger directly at the mechanical stamp slot.
scenes.motion: Marta leans slightly forward and taps the outer metal casing of the yellow box gently.
scenes.object_action: Marta touches the outer side of the yellow ticket validator.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.fa: این فقط بلیط‌های کاغذی معمولی را باطل می‌کند.
scenes.scene: Medium shot of Lukas producing an old paper ticket slip from his pocket to demonstrate its thin strip.
scenes.motion: Lukas wiggles the flexible paper strip in the air beside the validator post.
scenes.object_action: Lukas holds a small paper ticket next to the yellow validator post.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.fa: خوب است، کارت تراشه‌دارم سالم می‌ماند!
scenes.scene: Closer framing of Marta inspecting the corners of her plastic card with an amused grin.
scenes.motion: Marta wipes a tiny dust speck off her card and slides it securely into her coat pocket.
scenes.object_action: Marta slips the plastic chip card into her front coat pocket.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.scene: Medium shot of Lukas glancing up at the glowing overhead platform display board.
scenes.motion: Lukas points up toward the platform indicator board as train headlights reflect along the tracks.
scenes.object_action: Lukas points his hand toward the overhead platform display board.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.scene: Medium shot of Marta turning toward the arriving train with confident posture, tapping her jacket pocket.
scenes.motion: Marta pats her coat pocket where the ticket rests, smiles broadly, and steps forward toward the opening train doors.
scenes.object_action: Marta pats the pocket containing her plastic chip card and reaches for the train door button.
